notice: Sample answer: illustrative responses in the style of Northstar Ask over a fictional retail dataset. In SAMPLE_MODE every spoken reply is prefixed 'Sample answer:' by the client so nothing recorded is presented as live. Figures are precomputed from the fictional dataset.
card_contract: Per issue #134: brief responses carry cards ONLY in the 'cards' array; single-answer responses (ask, follow-up, breakdown, explain, low-confidence, feedback-improved) carry ONE card in the singular 'card' field. The two shapes never mix, so no card is ever rendered twice.

confidence_mapping.description: Confidence values are mapped from internal scoring ranges
confidence_mapping.high: Score >= 0.8 - High certainty in the answer's accuracy
confidence_mapping.medium: Score >= 0.5 and < 0.8 - Moderate certainty, answer is directionally correct
confidence_mapping.low: Score < 0.5 - Low certainty, answer may be speculative or incomplete

responses.question: How much revenue did Northstar make last quarter?
responses.spoken: Last quarter, Northstar Outdoor Co. booked about 770 thousand dollars in revenue. That was down about 10.8 percent from the prior quarter.

responses.question: Which region sold the most tents this year?
responses.spoken: The Pacific region leads tent sales this year with about 235 thousand dollars. Mountain is second at about 224 thousand dollars.

responses.question: And last quarter?
responses.context: Follows ask_top_region_tents in the same session.
responses.spoken: In Q2 2026, Mountain led tent sales at about 107 thousand dollars, ahead of Pacific. For the year so far, Pacific still leads.

responses.question: Break that down by sales channel.
responses.context: Follows followup_last_quarter in the same session.
responses.spoken: In the Mountain region, wholesale made up 63 percent of Q2 2026 tent revenue, online made up 19 percent and retail made up 17 percent.

card.title: Mountain Tent Revenue by Channel — Q2 2026

responses.question: What does that number mean for the business?
responses.spoken: In Q2 2026, revenue was down 10.8 percent versus Q1 2026. The biggest channel was online. For the first half of 2026, revenue was about 1.63 million dollars compared to about 2.01 million dollars in the first half of 2025 (down 18.7 percent).

responses.question: Are returns hurting our margins in the Central region?
responses.spoken: I'm not confident in this one. Return counts in the Central region are low but the demo dataset doesn't carry margin detail, so this is directional only.

responses.question: Which region sold the most sleeping bags last quarter?
responses.spoken: Improved from your feedback: the Central region led sleeping-bag sales last quarter at about 68 thousand dollars, ahead of the Pacific region.

card.title: Sleeping Bag Sales by Region — Q2 2026

responses.question: Give me the weekly business brief.
responses.spoken: Here's your weekly brief. Revenue is down 11 percent quarter over quarter, the Pacific region leads overall, and online is the biggest channel (it grew from Q1 2026).
